name: File format detection by signature
mathematical_principle: Content sniffing: PLY magic "ply\n" + format line; binary STL iff 84 + 50*n == file size where n = uint32 at offset 80; ASCII STL iff first non-blank token "solid" AND a "facet" token within the first 4 KiB AND the size rule fails; OBJ iff lines begin with v/vn/vt/f/o/g/#. Extension is ignored (FR-010).
operation_sequence: 1 read first 4 KiB and file size; 2 apply PLY rule; 3 apply binary-STL size rule (before ASCII rule: binary files may start with "solid"); 4 apply ASCII-STL rule; 5 apply OBJ grammar sniff; 6 otherwise FILE_UNREADABLE (unknown format).
outputs: format enum {stl_bin, stl_ascii, obj, ply_ascii, ply_bin_le, ply_bin_be} + notices
numerical_limits: None (byte rules).
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Binary STL whose 80-byte header starts with "solid"; truncated binary STL (size rule fails); UTF-8 BOM; CRLF line ends; empty file; ZIP/other binary renamed .stl.
libraries: Own (Python stdlib). Oracle: trimesh loader dispatch (LIB-TRIMESH).
alternatives: Trust extension (rejected: FR-010); libmagic (adds C dependency, no mesh rules).
test_unit: One fixture per format incl. binary STL with "solid" header; empty and random-bytes files.
test_synthetic_geometry: T4 format set (same object in 6 encodings).
test_edge_cases: Truncated binary STL; BOM; header-only file.
test_regression: Format fixtures frozen with expected enum.
test_numerical_stability: N/A — exact/combinatorial logic (no floating-point decision)
test_geometric_invariants: Detection independent of file name.
test_performance: None needed (constant time).

name: STL parsing (binary and ASCII)
mathematical_principle: Binary: 80-byte header, uint32 n, n records of 12 float32 + uint16 attribute (little-endian), parsed with a numpy structured dtype; ASCII: streaming tokenizer over "facet normal / outer loop / vertex x y z / endloop / endfacet". Stored normals are ignored (recomputed from winding).
operation_sequence: 1 validate n against size and face cap N_max (SEC-07) before allocation; 2 np.frombuffer with dtype [("n","<f4",3),("v","<f4",(3,3)),("a","<u2")]; 3 upcast to float64; 4 reject non-finite coordinates; 5 ASCII: tokenise line by line with a hard token/line limit, accumulate vertex triples, reject facets with != 3 vertices; 6 emit triangle soup (3n×3 float64).
computational_complexity: Binary O(n) vectorised; ASCII O(bytes) tokenizer-bound [H]
numerical_limits: float32 → float64 is exact; ASCII decimal → float64 rounding ≤ 0.5 ulp (Python float()).
known_errors_and_edge_cases: n = 0 (FILE_EMPTY); n × 50 + 84 ≠ size (truncated → FILE_UNREADABLE); NaN/Inf coordinates; ASCII with missing endloop; scientific notation; locale commas (reject); >N_max facets (face bomb).
libraries: Own (numpy). Oracle: trimesh (process=False), numpy-stl (BSD-3) as second oracle.
alternatives: trimesh.load (merges vertices by default, must pass process=False [N]); numpy-stl (BSD-3).
test_unit: Hand-built 1- and 2-facet files; header with "solid"; attribute bytes non-zero.
test_synthetic_geometry: Icosphere written by FN-KIO-06 then re-read.
test_edge_cases: Truncated, NaN, face bomb (n = 2^31 claimed), 0 facets.
test_regression: Byte fixtures with expected soup hash.
test_numerical_stability: Round-trip float32→float64→float32 identity.
test_geometric_invariants: Facet count = n; soup order = file order.
test_performance: BM-01 parse time vs n (binary and ASCII).

name: OBJ parsing with polygon triangulation
mathematical_principle: Line grammar: "v x y z [w]" and "f a[/t][/n] …" with 1-based and negative (relative) indices; vt/vn/mtllib/usemtl/o/g ignored with notice. Polygons with k > 3 vertices are triangulated in their best-fit plane (Newell normal) by ear clipping (ALG-25) — fan triangulation only when the polygon is convex in that plane.
operation_sequence: 1 stream lines with per-line length cap; 2 collect vertices (float64); 3 resolve indices (negative → len+idx); 4 reject out-of-range; 5 for k = 3 emit; k = 4..K_max triangulate (Newell normal, project, convexity test with exact orient2d, fan if convex else ear clipping); 6 notices: textures ignored, n polygons triangulated, n non-planar polygons (max distance to plane).
outputs: indexed vertices float64[nv,3] + faces int32[m,3] + notices
computational_complexity: O(bytes) + Σ O(k²) for ear clipping of k-gons
numerical_limits: Planarity reported, not repaired; projection loses nothing for planar quads.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Negative indices; faces before vertices; "f" with 2 vertices; non-planar or self-overlapping quads; w component; line continuation "\"; >K_max-gon.
alternatives: Fan triangulation only (wrong on concave polygons); trimesh loader (behaviour on concave polygons to verify [H]).
test_unit: Quads (convex/concave), negative indices, texture coords ignored with notice.
test_synthetic_geometry: T4 OBJ with quads and negative indices vs STL of same object.
test_edge_cases: Degenerate polygon, out-of-range index, empty face line.
test_numerical_stability: Triangulated area = polygon area (exact for planar).
test_geometric_invariants: Triangulated faces keep polygon orientation.
test_performance: BM-01 parse time.

name: PLY parsing (ASCII, binary LE/BE)
mathematical_principle: Header grammar (element/property/list); body parsed per declared element; vertex x,y,z (float/double), face list (uchar/int count + int indices); other properties skipped by declared size. Binary bodies via numpy dtypes with declared endianness.
operation_sequence: 1 parse header with line and element-count caps; 2 compute fixed record size for non-list elements; 3 vertex block via np.frombuffer; 4 face block: variable-length lists parsed with a bounded loop or, when all counts equal 3, a vectorised view; 5 polygons k > 3 → ALG-03 step 5; 6 notices for colour/normal/other properties.
numerical_limits: float32 vertices upcast exactly; double kept.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Big-endian; list count type uint8 vs int32; extra elements (edges, materials); comments; obj_info; count mismatch vs body length; point clouds without faces (FILE_EMPTY for faces).
libraries: Own. NOT plyfile (GPL-3.0-or-later per PyPI metadata, LIB-PLYFILE) — excluded by ADR-011. Oracle: trimesh.
alternatives: plyfile (GPL, rejected); trimesh PLY loader (MIT) as production fallback [H].
test_unit: ASCII, binary LE, binary BE fixtures; extra properties.
test_synthetic_geometry: T4 PLY vs STL of same object.
test_edge_cases: Count mismatch, truncated body, huge declared count.
test_numerical_stability: Exactness of double vertices.
test_geometric_invariants: Same V/F as STL import of the same object after ALG-05.

name: Indexed mesh construction with exact vertex merge
mathematical_principle: Bitwise-exact vertex welding: identical float64 triples (after canonicalising −0.0 to +0.0) map to one index; no epsilon welding (05 §1.1, avoids silently changing topology). Implementation: np.unique on a void/structured view of the (n,3) array with return_inverse; first-occurrence order kept by sorting unique indices by first appearance so output order is deterministic.
operation_sequence: 1 canonicalise −0.0; 2 unique rows with first-occurrence ordering; 3 faces = inverse.reshape(-1,3); 4 drop nothing (degenerate faces are reported by ALG-08, not removed); 5 validate indices and finiteness; 6 build report (input soup size, unique vertices, merged count).
inputs: triangle soup float64[3m,3] or indexed arrays
outputs: DS-01 MeshArrays (V float64, F int32, face order = file order)
numerical_limits: Exact equality only; near-duplicates (e.g. 1e-12 apart) stay separate and appear as boundary/non-manifold metrics.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Near-duplicate vertices from exporters; NaN (rejected earlier); > 2^31−1 vertices (rejected by cap).
alternatives: Epsilon welding (rejected: changes topology silently); trimesh merge_vertices (tolerance-based [N]).
test_unit: Shared-vertex soup → expected V/F; −0.0 vs 0.0 merge.
test_regression: Order fixture: shuffled soup gives identical V order rule.
test_numerical_stability: Bit equality of retained vertices.
test_geometric_invariants: len(V) ≤ 3m; F indices < len(V); geometry of every face unchanged bitwise.
test_performance: BM-01 at 10^4…10^6 faces.

name: Binary STL writer and independent re-read comparison
mathematical_principle: Write: float64 → float32 rounding (round-to-nearest), facet normal = normalised (b−a)×(c−a) in float64 then cast, attribute 0, little-endian, 80-byte ASCII header with schema id and design id (no patient data). Re-read: parse with an implementation independent of the writer (FN-KIO-02 own parser vs oracle second reader) and compare per vertex in face order: max |v_file − v_approved| ≤ file-fidelity tolerance 1e-4 mm (DEC-025).
operation_sequence: 1 transform to F_export (ALG-52); 2 cast; 3 write; 4 SHA-256 of bytes; 5 re-read; 6 compare counts and max deviation; 7 release only on pass.
outputs: STL bytes, sha256, ReimportResult {passed, max_dev_mm, n_tri}
numerical_limits: float32 spacing at 200 mm ≈ 1.5e-5 mm (2^-23 × 128 mm) → rounding ≤ 7.6e-6 mm < 1e-4 mm [N, derived].
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Coordinates far from origin increase float32 rounding (export frame keeps the head near the origin); degenerate faces give zero normals (written as 0,0,0).
libraries: Own (numpy). Second reader: numpy-stl (BSD-3) or trimesh (MIT) — whichever is not the production parser.
alternatives: ASCII STL (larger, decimal rounding); 3MF (post-MVP, FN-PMV-11).
test_unit: Known triangle → known bytes; header content check.
test_synthetic_geometry: T10 export round-trip with corruption injection.
test_numerical_stability: Max rounding error vs analytic float32 bound.
test_geometric_invariants: Triangle count preserved; orientation preserved; laterality preserved (VER-03).
test_performance: BM-07 export time.

name: Edge topology, boundary loops and non-manifold detection
brief_topic: mesh validation / boundary detection / hole detection / manifold validation
mathematical_principle: Undirected edge key k = (min(a,b), max(a,b)) per face edge; incidence count c(k) by sort + run-length. c = 1 → boundary edge, c = 2 → interior, c > 2 → non-manifold edge. Boundary loops: directed boundary half-edges form a functional graph; trace cycles starting from the smallest vertex id. Non-manifold vertex: the faces around a vertex form more than one edge-connected fan (count fans with union-find over faces sharing an edge incident to the vertex). Loop perimeter = Σ edge lengths.
operation_sequence: 1 build 3m directed half-edges; 2 undirected keys, lexsort, counts; 3 classify; 4 boundary half-edges map start→end; vertices with several outgoing boundary edges are non-manifold boundary vertices — loops split at them deterministically (smallest next id); 5 per-vertex fan count; 6 report counts, loops (vertex lists, perimeter, bbox), non-manifold elements (≤ 100 samples).
numerical_limits: Combinatorial (exact); perimeters inherit float64 rounding only.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Bow-tie vertices; boundary loops touching at a vertex; isolated vertices (reported, not removed); duplicate faces (c = 2 with same orientation → flagged by ALG-10).
libraries: Own (numpy, scipy.sparse). Oracle: trimesh graph utilities, CGAL PMP (oracle job).
alternatives: Half-edge data structure (OpenMesh BSD, LIB-OPENMESH) — cannot represent non-manifold input, so metrics must be computed before it.
test_unit: Single triangle (3 boundary edges, 1 loop); two triangles sharing an edge; three faces on one edge (non-manifold).
test_synthetic_geometry: T3 holes of set perimeter; icosphere (0 boundary, χ = 2).
test_numerical_stability: Perimeter of a circular hole of radius r vs 2πr minus chord error.
test_geometric_invariants: Σ c(k) = 3m; χ = V − E + F; loops partition boundary edges.
test_performance: BM-01 at 10^4…10^6 faces.

name: Degenerate face detection
mathematical_principle: Face area A = ½‖(b−a)×(c−a)‖ (float64). Degenerate iff A ≤ ε_area OR exact collinearity (orient-type test on the three points in their best plane) OR repeated vertex index. Needle/cap faces reported separately by min angle (diagnostic only).
operation_sequence: 1 vectorised cross products; 2 index-repeat check; 3 compare with ε_area (constant from VER-01 numerical analysis, OQ-FS-13); 4 report count + samples.
numerical_limits: Area of a 0.1 mm triangle ≈ 4e-3 mm²; float64 noise on coordinates ~200 mm ≈ 3e-14 mm → noise in A ≈ 1e-14 mm² [N, derived]; ε_area TBD (OQ-FS-13).
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Sliver faces that are not exactly zero area; faces with repeated vertex after exact merge.
alternatives: Relative ε (fraction of median face area) — proposed alternative in OQ-FS-13.
test_unit: Zero-area, collinear, repeated-index, valid faces.
test_numerical_stability: Scale invariance check: scaling by s scales A by s².
test_geometric_invariants: Count independent of face order.
test_performance: Negligible.

name: Connected components
mathematical_principle: Graph on faces with an edge for each shared undirected edge (manifold or not) → scipy.sparse.csgraph.connected_components; components ordered by (−face count, min face id) for deterministic labels.
operation_sequence: 1 face adjacency from ALG-07 edge keys; 2 connected_components (BFS, deterministic); 3 relabel by size order; 4 per component: faces, area, bbox, boundary loops.
outputs: {n_components, components[{label, n_faces, area_mm2, bbox}]}, face→label array
numerical_limits: Combinatorial.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Components connected only through a vertex (counted separate under edge-connectivity — documented rule); isolated vertices.
alternatives: Vertex-connectivity (merges bow-ties); union-find own.
test_unit: Two disjoint spheres → 2; bow-tie → 2 (edge rule).
test_numerical_stability: N/A — exact/combinatorial logic (no floating-point decision)
test_geometric_invariants: Σ faces = m; labels independent of input face permutation up to the documented order rule.

name: Orientation consistency, outward test and recorded re-orientation
mathematical_principle: Consistency: for every manifold interior edge the two incident faces must traverse it in opposite directions (directed half-edge appears once in each direction). Outward test: closed component → signed volume V = (1/6) Σ a·(b×c) > 0; open scan → hint only: mean of n_f·(c_f − centroid) weighted by area > 0, flagged as heuristic. Re-orientation: BFS over faces from the largest-area face, flipping neighbours with inconsistent winding; ambiguous (non-orientable) components reported.
operation_sequence: 1 count inconsistent interior edges; 2 per component signed volume (closed) or heuristic hint (open); 3 optional recorded op normalise_orientation (only if OQ-FS-37 = a) — never silent; 4 closure faces created by ALG-24 are oriented by construction.
numerical_limits: Signed volume summed in face order (determinism); translation-invariant formula uses centroid shift to reduce cancellation.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Möbius-like scans (non-orientable); inward-wound scans; components with holes (no volume).
alternatives: trimesh fix_normals (applies changes; not allowed silently); ray-parity outward test (fails on open meshes).
test_unit: Sphere with one flipped face → 3 inconsistent edges; inverted sphere → negative volume.
test_synthetic_geometry: T3 flipped faces; T6 sign sphere.
test_numerical_stability: Volume of icosphere vs (4/3)πr³ minus discretisation (DEC-025 table).
test_geometric_invariants: Flipping all faces negates volume; translation leaves volume unchanged.

name: Self-intersection detection with exact predicates
function_ids: FN-KVL-05; FN-KVL-05.1; FN-KVL-05.2; FN-KVL-05.3; FN-KVL-05.4; FN-KOP-13
mathematical_principle: Broad phase: AABB BVH (median split on centroid, deterministic) or sweep-and-prune over sorted boxes; candidate pairs i < j with overlapping boxes. Narrow phase: Guigue–Devillers triangle–triangle overlap built only from orient3d/orient2d signs; signs evaluated by a floating-point filter (static error bound) with exact fallback (Shewchuk adaptive arithmetic or rational arithmetic). Adjacent pairs: shared edge → intersect iff coplanar and overlapping on the same side (fold); shared vertex → test whether the opposite edge of each triangle crosses the other triangle.
operation_sequence: 1 face AABBs (float64, inflated by 0 — exact boxes); 2 BVH build; 3 traverse self-pairs; 4 classify pair adjacency via vertex sets; 5 non-adjacent: GD test; 6 count + up to 100 sample pairs/points; 7 incremental mode: query only faces touching moved vertices against the full BVH (box refit, no rebuild); 8 time budget per call → SELF_INTERSECTION_TIMEOUT, never "0".
computational_complexity: O(m log m + k) expected for BVH with k candidate pairs [N]; worst case O(m²) for pathological overlap (ghost layers produce many candidates) [H]
numerical_limits: Float-only Möller test gives false results on near-coplanar layers [N F-SRC-01]; exact signs remove rounding errors entirely; filter success rate on scans is a hypothesis [H].
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Coplanar overlapping triangles; triangles touching at a point; duplicate faces; ghost layers (two near-identical surfaces); degenerate faces (handled as segments/points).
libraries: Own (numpy + numba LIB-NUMBA candidate for inner loops) with own port of Shewchuk predicates (public domain, LIB-PREDICATES). Oracle: CGAL PMP does_self_intersect (GPL, CI only, LIB-CGAL).
alternatives: CGAL (GPL/commercial, OQ-G5); libigl copyleft/cgal (GPL); MeshLib (commercial licence, LIB-MESHLIB); Möller float test (rejected alone).
test_unit: Hand-built pairs: crossing, touching edge, touching vertex, coplanar overlap, coplanar disjoint, shared-edge fold, shared-vertex crossing.
test_synthetic_geometry: T3 self-intersection and ghost-layer fixtures; T8 property-based random zones.
test_edge_cases: Triangles offset by 1 ulp; tiny/huge coordinates; duplicate faces.
test_regression: Counts equal to CGAL oracle on VER-08 (FN-OPS-07).
test_numerical_stability: Perturbation test: translate/scale by powers of two (exact) → identical count.
test_geometric_invariants: Count invariant under face permutation and exact rigid motions (permutations of axes).
test_performance: X-02 / BM-01: time vs m for clean phantoms and ghost-layer fixtures; incremental mode time vs moved-vertex count.

name: Watertightness, signed volume and bounding box
mathematical_principle: Watertight iff no boundary edges and no non-manifold edges (ALG-07). Volume by divergence theorem V = (1/6) Σ (a−o)·((b−o)×(c−o)) with o = bbox centre (reduces cancellation). Axis-aligned bbox in the current frame.
operation_sequence: 1 reuse ALG-07; 2 volume in face order; 3 bbox min/max; 4 report.
numerical_limits: Relative error of V ~ m·ε_mach [N]; volume is meaningful only for closed meshes (flagged otherwise).
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Open meshes (volume = null, not a number); inverted orientation (negative volume reported).
alternatives: trimesh.volume (same formula [N]).
test_unit: Unit cube = 1; tetrahedron analytic.
test_numerical_stability: Translation by 10^4 mm changes V by < 1e-9 relative.
test_geometric_invariants: Rigid motion invariance of V; bbox of union ⊇ parts.
test_performance: Negligible.

name: Composite solid validity (validate.solid)
mathematical_principle: Conjunction of geometric checks: boundary edges = 0; non-manifold edges = 0; non-manifold vertices = 0; self-intersections = 0 (ALG-11); components = 1; inconsistent edges = 0; signed volume > 0 (outward); degenerate faces = 0. Each check reported separately with label "geometric check" (FR-082).
operation_sequence: 1 run ALG-07, -08, -09, -10, -11, -12; 2 evaluate checks in fixed order; 3 produce ValidityReport bound to geometry_sha.
numerical_limits: Exact for all combinatorial checks; volume sign exact via exact predicates when |V| is below a filter bound [H].
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Valid but thin walls (not checked in MVP — positive is solid); multiple shells.
libraries: Own; oracle manifold3d status (Manifold accepts only valid manifolds, LIB-MANIFOLD) and CGAL.
alternatives: manifold3d constructor as validity oracle (reports error status for non-manifold input [N]).
test_unit: Each defect type fails exactly its check.
test_numerical_stability: N/A — exact/combinatorial logic (no floating-point decision)
test_geometric_invariants: All checks pass on analytic closed phantoms.

name: Vertex normal estimation (angle-weighted)
mathematical_principle: n_v = normalise(Σ_f α_{f,v} n_f) with α the interior angle of face f at v (Thürmer–Wüthrich); face normal from winding. Summation in face order for determinism. Zero-length result (cancellation) → fallback to area-weighted, flagged.
operation_sequence: 1 face normals (unnormalised cross, then normalised); 2 corner angles via atan2(‖u×w‖, u·w) (stable); 3 scatter-add with np.add.at in face order; 4 normalise; 5 flag degenerate vertices.
numerical_limits: atan2 form avoids acos domain errors; np.add.at deterministic but slower than bincount [N].
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Vertices on sharp creases (wall/cap edges of the positive); isolated vertices; degenerate faces (zero weight).
alternatives: Area-weighted (default in many libraries); uniform; PCA normals for point clouds (Open3D) — not needed for meshes.
test_unit: Cube corner normal = (1,1,1)/√3; sphere vertex normal vs radial direction.
test_numerical_stability: Invariance to uniform scaling and to face subdivision on planar regions.
test_geometric_invariants: Normals flip when all faces flip.
test_performance: Negligible.

name: Recorded face removal and compaction (mesh cleaning)
mathematical_principle: Remove a set of face ids (from UI selection or component labels) and compact vertices keeping relative order; record (op type, op_version, face_ids on input mesh) so replay is exact (FR-020, FR-023).
operation_sequence: 1 validate ids ⊂ [0,m); 2 keep-mask; 3 new F = F[keep]; 4 used vertices in original order → remap; 5 report removed faces/vertices, new boundary loops.
outputs: DS-01 + map old→new vertex ids (for anchors)
numerical_limits: Exact (no coordinates change).
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Removing all faces (rejected); removal creating non-manifold vertices (reported by ALG-07).
alternatives: Region growing by curvature (post-MVP segmentation, ALG-43).
test_unit: Remove one face; remove a component.
test_synthetic_geometry: Sphere + extra component → remove component → 1 component.
test_regression: Disable all cleanup ops reproduces original hash (TC-FR-023).
test_numerical_stability: N/A — exact/combinatorial logic (no floating-point decision)
test_geometric_invariants: Remaining face coordinates bit-identical.
test_performance: Negligible.

name: Hole filling: minimum-weight triangulation + refinement (+ optional fairing)
mathematical_principle: Liepa (2003): (1) triangulate the boundary polygon by dynamic programming minimising (max dihedral angle, then area) — O(n³); (2) refine patch so triangle sizes match the boundary edge density (σ-density criterion, Delaunay-like edge swaps); (3) optional fairing by solving a discrete (bi)Laplacian with boundary rings fixed (sparse SPD solve). New faces tagged synthetic.
operation_sequence: 1 take technician-selected loop ids (OQ-FS-16) with perimeter ≤ P; 2 reject loops with > n_max vertices (bounds O(n³); constant TQ-12); 3 DP triangulation with deterministic tie-break (lexicographic on vertex ids); 4 refinement; 5 fairing if flag; 6 orientation consistent with surrounding faces; 7 post-op guard ALG-50.
inputs: DS-01 + loop ids + max_perimeter_mm + fairing flag
computational_complexity: O(n³) per loop (DP) + sparse solve O(p^1.5) typical for p patch vertices [N]
numerical_limits: Fairing solve: conjugate gradient with fixed tolerance & iteration cap (deterministic single-thread) or direct sparse LU (scipy SuperLU) [H].
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Non-planar saddle holes; loops touching other loops; islands inside holes; loops on a non-oriented neighbourhood (precondition fails).
libraries: Own (numpy, scipy.sparse). Oracle: CGAL triangulate_refine_and_fair_hole (CI). Fallback for tiny loops: VTK vtkFillHolesFilter (BSD) [N].
alternatives: trimesh fill_holes (trivial holes only [N]); alpha wrap (moves whole surface, rejected); screened Poisson (replaces surface).
test_unit: Planar circular hole → patch planar; triangle count ~ boundary density.
test_synthetic_geometry: T3 holes of set perimeter on sphere (fill restores closedness; patch deviation from sphere reported).
test_edge_cases: Loop of 3 vertices; loop above n_max → rejected; saddle hole.
test_numerical_stability: Fairing convergence and determinism (100 runs).
test_geometric_invariants: Faces outside patch bit-identical; boundary vertices fixed; result loop count decreases by number of filled loops.
test_performance: Time vs loop size n (n³ growth).

name: Quadric error metric decimation with topology constraints
mathematical_principle: Garland–Heckbert: each vertex accumulates Q = Σ p pᵀ over incident face planes; edge collapse cost = v̄ᵀ(Q₁+Q₂)v̄ at the optimal or endpoint position; greedy by priority queue. Constraints: link condition (prevents non-manifold), boundary-edge lock (or boundary quadrics), normal-flip rejection, minimum triangle quality. Deterministic tie-break: (cost, min vertex id).
operation_sequence: 1 quadrics; 2 heap of candidate edges; 3 collapse while faces > target and constraints hold; 4 compact; 5 report one-sided Hausdorff (ALG-41) between output vertices and input surface; 6 LOD output flagged display_only (INV-10).
numerical_limits: Optimal position solve 3×3 may be singular → fall back to endpoint/midpoint.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Thin features collapse; boundaries; already-coarse meshes; non-manifold input (refused).
libraries: Candidates: VTK vtkQuadricDecimation (BSD-3), fast-simplification (MIT), Open3D simplify_quadric_decimation (MIT), meshoptimizer (MIT, LOD only); own implementation as fallback.
alternatives: Vertex clustering (fast, poor quality); edge-length based; remeshing (ALG-20).
test_unit: Planar grid decimates to 2 triangles with zero error.
test_synthetic_geometry: Icosphere s=7 → targets; Hausdorff vs analytic sphere.
test_numerical_stability: Singular quadric fallback.
test_geometric_invariants: Output manifold if input manifold; Euler characteristic preserved (genus kept).
test_performance: Time vs m; LOD build time.

name: Local windowed-sinc smoothing (Taubin/VTK style) with blended rim
mathematical_principle: Low-pass filter on the graph Laplacian approximated by a windowed Chebyshev expansion (windowed sinc, pass-band k_PB, N iterations) — negligible shrinkage compared with uniform Laplacian [P G-SRC-12]. Applied only to the technician region: submesh = vertices with w > 0, rim vertices fixed; final position v' = v + w(ρ)(v_s − v) with smoothstep w across the transition (OQ-FS-20). Outside region bit-identical.
operation_sequence: 1 region from anchored centre + radius + transition (Euclidean, as zones); 2 extract submesh with one fixed ring; 3 filter (normalised coordinates, as VTK does); 4 blend by w; 5 guard ALG-50; 6 report max/RMS deviation (ALG-41); 7 measurements refuse smoothed artifacts (FR-179).
inputs: DS-01 + centre anchor + radius_mm + transition_mm + iterations + passband
numerical_limits: VTK normalises coordinates to a unit box before filtering [N]; own implementation must match for parameter equivalence.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Region touching closure faces (excluded: smoothing only on scan-origin faces); region covering whole mesh; N = 0.
libraries: VTK vtkWindowedSincPolyDataFilter (BSD-3) candidate; own numpy/scipy.sparse implementation fallback.
alternatives: Taubin λ/μ (F-SRC-06); bilateral; Laplacian (rejected, shrinkage).
test_unit: Plane stays plane; sphere radius change below tolerance for given N.
test_synthetic_geometry: Noisy sphere (seeded) → RMS noise reduced, mean radius kept.
test_numerical_stability: Pass-band edge cases (0.001…0.1).
test_geometric_invariants: Vertices outside region+transition bit-identical (FR-179 AC).
test_performance: Time vs region size.

name: Mesh denoising (feature-preserving)
mathematical_principle: Bilateral normal filtering (Zheng et al. 2011): filter face normals with spatial and range kernels, then update vertices to fit filtered normals.
operation_sequence: Outline only: normal filtering iterations; vertex update iterations; report deviation.
numerical_limits: Parameter-sensitive (σ_s, σ_r).

name: Plane section to contours with symbolic tie rule
function_ids: FN-KMS-01; FN-KMS-01.1; FN-KMS-01.2; FN-KMS-01.3; FN-KOP-06.1; FN-KOP-09
mathematical_principle: Signed distances d_i = n̂·(v_i − p). Symbolic perturbation: d = 0 is treated as positive, so no vertex lies on the plane and every crossed edge (sign change) yields exactly one point x = v_a + d_a/(d_a − d_b)(v_b − v_a). Each crossed face contributes one segment; segments chained through shared edges into closed contours or open polylines.
operation_sequence: 1 d_i; 2 sign bits with tie rule; 3 crossed edges (unique edge keys); 4 interpolate points once per edge (shared by both faces → exact chaining); 5 face → segment; 6 chain via edge adjacency, start at smallest edge key, orientation counter-clockwise about n̂; 7 classify closed/open.
outputs: DS-09 contours (closed/open, points float64[k,3], source edge keys)
numerical_limits: Interpolation divides by (d_a − d_b) which is non-zero by construction of the sign change; point accuracy limited by float64; chord error vs smooth surface is a mesh property (DEC-025 perimeter 0.032 mm on R = 75 mm s=6).
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Plane through vertices/edges (tie rule); tangent plane (no crossing); multiple contours (ears, artefacts); boundary edges → open polylines.
alternatives: trimesh section (tie handling and order not specified for our contract [N]); VTK vtkCutter (BSD).
test_unit: Cube cut through vertices; tetrahedron cut through edge.
test_synthetic_geometry: Sphere section circle: perimeter vs 2πr within DEC-025.
test_edge_cases: Plane through many vertices; tangent plane; plane missing mesh.
test_numerical_stability: Tiny plane offsets (1 ulp) give topologically consistent contours.
test_geometric_invariants: Each crossed edge produces exactly one point; closed contours on closed meshes.
test_performance: Negligible (O(m)).

name: Positive closure: plane cut + prism wall + planar cap (option A)
brief_topic: open mesh to closed mesh conversion
function_ids: FN-KOP-06; FN-KOP-06.1; FN-KOP-06.2; FN-KOP-06.3; FN-KOP-06.4; FN-KOP-06.5
status: Proposed (position in op sequence blocked: OQ-FS-01)
mathematical_principle: Cut the open head surface with the configured base plane Π (ALG-23), keep the head side, require exactly one simple boundary contour C on Π and no other boundary, extrude C by e along the base normal n̂ (prism quads split into triangles), cap C' with a planar triangulation without Steiner points (ALG-25). Head-side vertices are copied bitwise (zero displacement above Π).
operation_sequence: 1 cut; 2 boundary loops of kept part; 3 one loop on Π else OP_REJECTED_OPEN_BOUNDARY / MULTIPLE_CONTOURS; 4 simplicity test (ALG-25) else OP_REJECTED_NON_SIMPLE_CONTOUR; 5 wall (if e > 0); 6 cap; 7 tag faces {scan, cut, wall, cap}; 8 orientation and volume > 0; 9 validate ALG-13.
computational_complexity: O(m) cut + O(k²) cap for k contour vertices (ear clipping)
numerical_limits: Cut points lie on Π within float64 rounding; cap vertices are the same array entries as wall/cut vertices (no re-computation) → watertight by construction.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Holes above Π (reject; requires fill or removal first); several contours (neck + artefact); contour self-touching; e = 0; Π not intersecting the scan.
libraries: Own (numpy) + ALG-25 (own ear clipping on exact orient2d, or mapbox-earcut ISC).
alternatives: Boolean union with base block via manifold3d (Apache-2.0) — reserve for fixture blocks (OQ-G1); alpha wrap (rejected: moves surface); hole filling of the opening (rejected: no flat base).
test_unit: Hemisphere + plane → closed solid with analytic volume.
test_edge_cases: Contour with 3 vertices; touching contour; e = 0; missing intersection.
test_numerical_stability: Base plane position within e = 0.011 mm (DEC-025).
test_geometric_invariants: Head-side vertices bit-identical; watertight; volume > 0; 1 component.
test_performance: Time vs contour size.

name: Polygon simplicity test and ear-clipping triangulation
brief_topic: open mesh to closed mesh conversion
mathematical_principle: Project contour to plane coordinates (orthonormal basis of Π). Simplicity: no two non-adjacent segments intersect (exact orient2d; O(k log k) Shamos–Hoey sweep or O(k²) brute force for k ≤ k_max). Ear clipping: repeatedly cut a convex vertex whose triangle contains no other reflex vertex (two-ears theorem guarantees an ear exists for simple polygons [N]); deterministic choice: smallest index ear.
operation_sequence: 1 2D projection; 2 orientation by signed area; 3 simplicity sweep; 4 ear clipping (k−2 triangles); 5 winding so that cap normals point along +n̂.
computational_complexity: Simplicity O(k log k) (sweep) or O(k²); ear clipping O(k²) worst case
numerical_limits: Exact orient2d removes collinearity misclassification; projection rounding cannot create crossings that are tested exactly on projected doubles (tested on projected values, consistent).
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Collinear consecutive points; duplicate points; very thin necks; k = 3.
libraries: mapbox-earcut 2.1.0 (ISC, LIB-EARCUT) or own; own exact orient2d (LIB-PREDICATES).
alternatives: Constrained Delaunay (Shewchuk Triangle — non-free commercial use, rejected); CDT in CGAL (GPL).
test_unit: Convex, concave, comb, spiral polygons.
test_numerical_stability: Area of triangulation = polygon area (exact rational check in tests).
test_geometric_invariants: k − 2 triangles; all CCW; union = polygon.
test_performance: k up to contour size of real scans (BM-02).

name: Anatomical frame construction from named landmarks
mathematical_principle: Clinic frame definition (DEC-027) names landmarks and rules: origin o (point | midpoint | centroid | projection); primary axis a₁ = normalise(p_j − p_i); reference plane normal from least-squares plane through ≥ 3 landmarks (SVD of centred points, smallest singular vector, sign fixed by a named landmark); a₂ = normalise(n − (n·a₁)a₁) (Gram–Schmidt); a₃ = a₁ × a₂; R = [a₁ a₂ a₃]ᵀ; assert det R = +1 ± 1e-9; laterality: sign of paired landmarks along M-L must match labels else warning.
operation_sequence: 1 evaluate anchors (ALG-33 evaluate); 2 origin; 3 axes; 4 orthonormality and det checks; 5 condition checks (baseline length b, plane fit residual, angle between a₁ and n not near 0); 6 laterality check; 7 store DS-06.
outputs: DS-06 F_scan→F_anat + quality report {baseline_mm, plane_rms_mm, min_angle_deg, laterality_ok}
numerical_limits: Axis angle error ≈ atan(2e/b) for landmark error e and baseline b (VERIFICATION_CRITERIA §2.3); SVD stable; near-parallel a₁ and n ill-conditioned → reject below configured angle.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Collinear plane landmarks; coincident landmarks; swapped L/R labels; missing landmark (LANDMARKS_INCOMPLETE).
alternatives: Kabsch/Umeyama template fit (post-MVP visit registration, F-SRC-07); PCA of scan (rejected: depends on scan extent).
test_unit: Analytic landmark sets → exact axes; swapped labels → warning.
test_synthetic_geometry: VER-01 phantoms with known landmarks; T7 rigid motions.
test_numerical_stability: Perturb landmarks by e → axis error ≤ atan(2e/b).
test_geometric_invariants: RᵀR = I; det = +1; frame equivariance under rigid motion of input.
test_performance: Negligible.

name: Rigid transform algebra and reflection guard
mathematical_principle: 4×4 homogeneous matrices with explicit (from, to) frame tags; composition checks tag compatibility; inverse via [Rᵀ, −Rᵀt]; validity: ‖RᵀR − I‖_F ≤ 1e-9 and det R = +1 ± 1e-9; any reflection (det −1) is rejected (SAF-03, ADR-009). Export frame F_export derived from F_anat by the configured rule (DEC-015).
operation_sequence: 1 construct; 2 validate; 3 compose; 4 apply to vertices (float64); 5 store matrix + det.
numerical_limits: Re-orthonormalise only at construction (polar decomposition) — never silently afterwards.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Tag mismatch; det −1 (mirroring); scale ≠ 1.
alternatives: Quaternion storage (no advantage for audit; matrices are what manifests carry).

test_geometric_invariants: T∘T⁻¹ = I; det preserved.
test_performance: Not separately budgeted (linear, small inputs); covered by BM-07 end-to-end timing

name: BVH closest point, anchor snap and anchor evaluation
mathematical_principle: AABB BVH over faces; closest point on triangle by Voronoi-region classification (Ericson) → (face_id, barycentric, feature type {face, edge, vertex}); ties (equal distance) broken by smallest face_id. Anchor evaluation x = b₀v_{f0} + b₁v_{f1} + b₂v_{f2} on any mesh with the same topology (design ops keep topology).
operation_sequence: 1 build BVH once per mesh (cached by mesh sha); 2 query with branch-and-bound on box distance; 3 exact tie rule; 4 return anchor + snap distance; 5 flag if snap distance > limit (OQ-FS-14).
computational_complexity: Build O(m log m); query O(log m) expected [N]
numerical_limits: Barycentrics clamped to the triangle by construction; stored coordinates lie on the surface within float64 rounding (< 1e-6 mm, TC-FR-030).
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Equidistant faces; query far from surface; degenerate faces.

name: Correction / relief zone displacement (plateau + smoothstep)
function_ids: FN-KOP-10; FN-KOP-10.1; FN-KOP-10.2; FN-KOP-10.3; FN-KOP-10.4; FN-DES-02.1
mathematical_principle: Centre c from anchor (face_id, bary) evaluated on the current positive; tangent basis (t₁, t₂) from the projected reference direction (OQ-FS-10); p = v − c; normalised radius ρ = ‖p‖/r (circle) or ρ = √((p·t̂₁/r₁)² + (p·t̂₂/r₂)² + (p·n̂_c/min(r₁,r₂))²) (ellipse rotated by α; FS FN-KOP-10 step 2) — Euclidean distance (A-15). Distance beyond the extent along the ray from c: u = ‖p‖(1 − 1/ρ) for ρ > 1. Weight w = 1 for ρ ≤ 1; w = S(1 − u/T) with S(x) = 3x² − 2x³ for 0 < u < T; w = 0 otherwise (equivalently 1 − S(u/T)). Displacement v' = v + m·w·n̂_v (m signed; + = outward on the positive = more space inside the device, SAF-10). Category (contact, growth void, relief, build-up) is metadata from clinic configuration; the operator is the same.
operation_sequence: 1 evaluate anchor; 2 basis; 3 ρ and u per vertex (only scan-origin vertices; closure faces excluded); 4 w; 5 displace; 6 guard ALG-50 (self-intersection, normal flips, sign check); 7 report max displacement, area affected.
computational_complexity: O(n) (or O(n_affected) with BVH range query)
numerical_limits: Max displacement exactly m at plateau vertices (floating point: v + m·n̂ rounding ≪ e); C¹ continuity at the transition; folds when m·κ large or T small.
known_errors_and_edge_cases: Zone reaching closure faces; zone across thin regions (Euclidean leak); m = 0; T = 0 (C⁰ step, allowed? configurable minimum).
alternatives: Laplacian surface editing (F-SRC-19), ARAP (F-SRC-18), RBF fields — post-MVP/research.
test_unit: Plane with zone: displacement profile matches w analytically.
test_synthetic_geometry: Sphere zone m: max = m ± e at centre; 0 outside extent+T (TC-FR-050); T6 sign sphere (VER-14).
test_edge_cases: Zone at the base; overlapping zones (ALG-47).
test_numerical_stability: C¹ check at ρ = 1 and u = T.
test_geometric_invariants: Vertices outside extent+T bit-identical; sign of m equals sign of deviation.
test_performance: Per-op time (X-04).
